description: Unit tests for the TimePurgePredicate class, testing its behavior in different cache timing scenarios.

classes.name: TimePurgePredicateTests
classes.description: Test class for TimePurgePredicate, containing various test cases to verify purge logic based on cache timing.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that a message not old enough to purge is correctly identified as not to be purged.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_PurgeDataThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that a message old enough to purge is correctly identified for purging.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeAgeThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that a message not old enough in terms of age is not purged.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeTimeInCacheThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that a message not in cache long enough is not purged despite age.
